messages:
Tanya: Quick postmortem follow-up for INC-2026-120. I pulled action items into Epic RI-7123: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-7123. Need owners + ETAs + RACI. TL;DR items: retry backoff safeguards, oncall rollback checklist, alert dedup rules, recurrence RCA.

omar: I can own retry backoff safeguards. Will make subtask and ETA = 1 week. @kelly can you help validate in staging?

kelly: Yup, I can validate. I'll add a small load test and a PASS checklist. Target verification next Wed.

Tanya: RACI suggestion for retry safeguards: omar (R), Tanya (A), kelly (C), infra-oncall (I). Agree?

omar: Sounds good. I'll set those on the ticket.

ops-bot: Created JIRA RI-7124 "Retry backoff safeguards + tests" assigned to omar. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-7124

kelly: I'll draft the rollback checklist and attach to RI-7125 when created. Need owner for rollback playbook updates.

Tanya: I'll take the rollback playbook update and oncall runbook edits. ETA: 3 business days.

ops-bot: Created JIRA RI-7125 "Rollback playbook + oncall runbook updates" assigned to Tanya. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-7125

omar: One ask: can we add a biweekly checkpoint on the epic until we see 2 clean weekly deploys? Helps close the loop.

Tanya: Agree  adding biweekly checkpoints. Also request that recurrence RCA ticket include cost impact estimate if capacity changes are recommended.

kelly: I'll open the RCA ticket for the recurring spike analysis and tag with 'kv-eviction' if logs show correlation. Creating RI-7126 now.

ops-bot: Created JIRA RI-7126 "Recurrence RCA: telemetry + synthetic" assigned to kelly. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-7126

omar: Drop an emoji when your ticket is linked in the epic so I can compile the remediation tracker. :white_check_mark:

Tanya: :thumbsup:

kelly: :heavy_check_mark:

ops-bot: Epic RI-7123 updated with subtasks RI-7124, RI-7125, RI-7126.
